ranking.note: Moved ahead of #26966 because it is the stated groundwork for it; same band, chain order.

inconsistencies: Dependency chain: #34489 (batched db writes, per its description "laying groundwork for parallel indexing in #26966") should be reviewed before #26966; reviewing the parallelization first risks rework of the same sync loop.

Overlapping scope: #24230 (stop using node internal types / cs_main in indexes) and #35474 (move index ownership from globals to NodeContext) both attack index/node decoupling for multiprocess work and touch the same ownership and lookup paths. #24230 is the broader change and should set the direction; #35474 should be reviewed against it rather than independently.

#35229 (CBlockIndex by reference, incl. CChain storing reference_wrapper) touches the same index-facing signatures that #24230 replaces with non-node types; if #24230 is accepted, part of #35229's index changes become moot.
result.notes: Bands unchanged from the individual assessments; the list already separates measured sync speedups and framework decoupling (P2) from narrower fixes and housekeeping (P3) and pure janitorial refactor (P4). Ordering within P2 follows the category's stated priorities: sync time/resource use ahead of decoupling, with the prerequisite first.
